This script generates summaries used in the manuscript.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

require("knitr")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, eval = T, message = F, warning = F)

# Load functions
source(here::here("R/functions.R"), echo = F)
ogl <- readRDS(here::here('raw_data/threats/OGL_polygons.rds'))
colgrid <- readRDS(paste0(envir,'/colonies.RDS'))

```

### Table S3: Summarize tracking effort

```{r}

dep <- read.csv(here::here("raw_data/MasterMetadata_LHSP_Tracking_NL_NB_NS_13Aug2024_GPSonly.csv"))|>
  dplyr::filter(colony != "Scatarie") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dep_brStatus = ifelse(is.na(dep_brStatus), "incubation", dep_brStatus),
                dep_brStatus = ifelse(dep_brStatus == "none", "incubation", dep_brStatus),
                colony = ifelse(grepl("Baccalieu", colony), "Baccalieu", colony))
# 'NA' and 'none' breeding status deploy dates all late June or early July, assume incubation for retrieval stats

sum <- dep |> 
  dplyr::group_by(colony, dep_yr, dep_brStatus) |>
  dplyr::summarize(nDep = dplyr::n(),
                   nRecap = sum(ret_birdYN == "y", na.rm = T),
                   nRet = sum(ret_tagYN == "y", na.rm = T),
                   nData = sum(!is.na(track_filename), na.rm = T),
                   .groups = "drop_last") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = dep_brStatus,
    values_from = c(nDep, nRecap, nRet, nData),
    names_glue = "{dep_brStatus}_{.value}",
    names_vary = "slowest"
  )

write.csv(sum, here::here('plots_man/tracking_effort_summary.csv'), row.names = F)

```

### Summarize densities over all colonies

Make overall summaries of density for each month.

```{r}

od <- here::here('plots_man/density_summaries')

for (dd in c('day','night')) {
  sdm_density_rast(colony = 'all', 
                   date = month.abb[6:9], 
                   brStatus = c('incubation','chick-rearing'), 
                   behaviour = c('Foraging','Transit'), 
                   tod = dd, 
                   sunLoc = c(-52.7988, 48.1165),    # defaults to Baccalieu
                   source = here::here('output_data/ltm_bart_birds'), 
                   destination = od
  )
}

sdm_density_rast(colony = 'all',
                 date = month.abb[6:9],
                 brStatus = c('incubation','chick-rearing'),
                 behaviour = c('Foraging','Transit'),
                 tod = c('day','night'),
                 sunLoc = c(-52.7988, 48.1165),    # defaults to Baccalieu
                 source = here::here('output_data/ltm_bart_birds'),
                 destination = od
)

```


### Table S7: Calculate densities by area

Summarize densities across status, behaviour, and time of day.

```{r}

od <- here::here('plots_man/all_risks')

lapply(colord, function(cn) {
  sdm_density_rast(colony = cn,
                   date = month.abb[6:9],
                   brStatus = c('incubation','chick-rearing'),
                   behaviour = c('Foraging','Transit'),
                   tod = c('day','night'),
                   sunLoc = c(-52.7988, 48.1165),    # defaults to Baccalieu
                   source = here::here('output_data/ltm_bart_birds'),
                   destination = od
  )
})

```

Extract densities within the licence areas. 

```{r}

out <- extract_dens(source = od, extract_areas = ogl, modlab = 'Breeding')

out <- out |> 
  dplyr::group_by(ProdArea,area_km2,Province,license_type,colony,month) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    med = sum(med),
    ll = sum(ll),
    ul = sum(ul)
  )

month_sum <- out |> 
  dplyr::group_by(Province, ProdArea, month, license_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dens_med = sum(med),
    dens_ll = sum(ll),
    dens_ul = sum(ul)
  )

month_sum |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = paste0(round(dens_med,2), ' (', round(dens_ll,2), '-', round(dens_ul, 2), ')')
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(-dens_med, -dens_ll, -dens_ul) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = value) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(ProdArea), license_type, Province) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Area = ProdArea, `License type`= license_type) |> 
  dplyr::select(`License type`, Province, Area, month.name[6:9]) |> 
  write.csv(here::here('plots_man/all_risk_summary.csv'),row.names = F)

```

```{r create-light-risk-rast}
})
```

Calculate the number of birds within a theoretical 89.3 km^2 light footprint if it were within each lease area. 

```{r light-nbirds}

light_buff <- 89.3
out_bs <- out |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    med = med * light_buff,
    ll = ll * light_buff,
    ul = ul * light_buff,
  )

month_sum_bs <- out_bs |> 
  dplyr::group_by(Province, ProdArea, month, license_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    dens_med = sum(med),
    dens_ll = sum(ll),
    dens_ul = sum(ul)
  )

month_sum_bs |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = paste0(round(dens_med,1), ' (', round(dens_ll,1), '-', round(dens_ul, 1), ')')
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(-dens_med, -dens_ll, -dens_ul) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = value) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(ProdArea), license_type, Province) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Area = ProdArea, `License type`= license_type) |> 
  dplyr::select(`License type`, Province, Area, June, July, August,September) |> 
  write.csv(here::here('plots_man/light_risk_summary.csv'),row.names = F)

```

### Summarize model performance

Calculate AUC for the withheld validation data.

```{r val-witheld}

options(java.parameters = "-Xmx20g")
library(bartMachine)

val_dat <- readRDS(here::here("input_data/LHSP_validation_data.RDS")) |> 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |> 
  na.omit()
mod <- readRDS(here::here('output_data/bart_model_full.RDS'))
pred <- predict(mod, new_data = val_dat[,names(mod$X)])
val_dat$pred_dyn <- pred

val_sum <- val_dat |> 
  dplyr::group_by(colony) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    WH_AUC = pROC::auc(pROC::roc(obs, pred_dyn))[[1]],
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    colony = factor(colony, levels = colord)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(colony)

val_sum <- rbind(
  val_sum,
  data.frame(colony = 'All', WH_AUC = mean(val_sum$WH_AUC))
)

```

Summarize AUC for the LOOCV by colony.

```{r val-loocv}
tg <- readRDS(here::here('output_data/bart_tune_grid.RDS')) |> 
  dplyr::filter(k == 2, num_trees == 200) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    colony = factor(colony, levels = colord)
  ) 

cv_sum <- tg |> 
  dplyr::group_by(colony) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    CV_AUC = mean(auc),
    SD = sd(auc)
  )

cv_sum <- rbind(
  cv_sum,
  data.frame(colony = 'All', CV_AUC = mean(cv_sum$CV_AUC), SD = NA)
)

out <- cv_sum |> 
  dplyr::select(colony, CV_AUC) |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(val_sum) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    CV_AUC = round(CV_AUC, 3),
    WH_AUC = round(WH_AUC, 3)
  )

```


```{r val-table-s5-auc}

write.csv(out, here::here('plots_man/AUC_table.csv'), row.names = F)

```

Calculate Continuous Boyce Index for validation data

```{r}

options(java.parameters = "-Xmx20g")
library(bartMachine)

val_dat <- readRDS(here::here("input_data/LHSP_validation_data.RDS")) |> 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |> 
  na.omit()
mod <- readRDS(here::here('output_data/bart_model_full.RDS'))
pred <- predict(mod, new_data = val_dat[,names(mod$X)])
val_dat$pred_dyn <- pred

```

```{r}

cbi_out <- vector('list', length(unique(val_dat$colony)))
names(cbi_out) <- unique(val_dat$colony)

for (cn in unique(val_dat$colony)) {
  fn <- list.files(here::here(paste('output_data/ltm_bart_pred/'), cn), full.names = T, recursive = T)
  
  out <- lapply(fn, function(f) {
    r <- terra::rast(f)
    r <- terra::quantile(r, 0.5)
    v <- strsplit(sub('.tif','',basename(f)), split = '_')[[1]]
    data.frame(terra::values(r, na.rm = T), 
               colony = v[1],
               month = v[2],
               status = v[3],
               behaviour = v[4],
               tod = v[5]
    )
  })
  
  out <- do.call(rbind, out)
  
  cbi_out[[cn]] <- ecospat::ecospat.boyce(fit = out$q0.5, 
                                          obs = val_dat$pred_dyn[val_dat$obs == 1], 
                                          nclass=0,
                                          window.w = 1/20,
                                          PEplot = FALSE, 
                                          rm.duplicate = TRUE, 
                                          method = 'spearman')
  print(paste('Finished:', cn))
  
}


```

```{r}

cbi_vals <- data.frame()
cbi_sum <- data.frame()

for (cn in names(cbi_out)) {
  idx <- 1
  while(cbi_out[[cn]]$F.ratio[idx + 1] < 1 & idx < 101) idx <- idx+1
  cbi_sum <- rbind(cbi_sum, 
                   data.frame(
                     colony = cn,
                     cbi = cbi_out[[cn]]$cor,
                     thresh = cbi_out[[cn]]$HS[idx]
                   ))
  cbi_vals <- rbind(cbi_vals, 
                    data.frame(
                      colony = cn,
                      F.ratio = cbi_out[[cn]]$F.ratio,
                      HS = cbi_out[[cn]]$HS
                    ))
  
}

ggplot(cbi_vals) +
  geom_line(aes(x = HS, y = F.ratio, col = colony)) 

cbi_sum
cbi_sum$colony <- factor(cbi_sum$colony, levels = c('Baccalieu','Gull','Middle Lawn','Country','Bon Portage','Kent'))
cbi_sum <- cbi_sum[as.numeric(cbi_sum$colony),]  
cbi_sum <- rbind(cbi_sum, 
                 data.frame(colony = 'All',cbi = mean(cbi_sum$cbi), thresh = mean(cbi_sum$thresh))
)
cbi_sum
```
